---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea — a new strategy, a new exchange, a new risk control.
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem does this solve?

What you can't do today and why it matters. Be specific. "I want to trade on
exchange X" is fine; "make the bot better" is not.

## Proposed solution

What you want to build. Module path is helpful (e.g. `src/clients/x_client.py`).

## Out of scope

What this feature is **not** trying to do. Helps avoid scope creep during PR review.

## Risks

What could go wrong with this feature in live mode? E.g. new partial-fill
modes, new fee curves, new auth schemes, new rate limit profiles.

## Alternatives considered

What else you considered and why this is better.

## Willing to send a PR?

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] Looking for someone else to implement
